stem: What was one way the constitutional amendment excerpted above helped advance the cause of gender equality?

options.label: F
options.text: It gave women a greater opportunity to influence government.

options.label: G
options.text: It gave women new economic rights, such as property ownership.

options.label: H
options.text: It established the idea that women should contribute to all sectors of the economy.

options.label: J
options.text: It contributed to a long-term decline in the number of men voting in elections.

visual_elements: The right of citizens of the United States to vote shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any State on account of sex. . . . — 19th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution
